sources.snippet: PointPillars # PointPillars is a model for 3D object detection in point cloud data. Unlike images, point cloud data is in-nature a collection of sparse points in 3D space. Each point cloud sample (example) is called a scene (stored as a file with .bin extension here). For each scene, it contains generally a variable number of points in 3D Euclidean space.
